pages.title: Life Comes Back
pages.text: The monolith brings prehistoric wildlife into a prepared habitat.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Amber sometimes yields Amber Curiosity. A monolith gradually repopulates local fauna over several game days, considering local species and nearby animals; do not force-load chunks.
